tweet.text:
All defaults for those: size-n 12, size-m 48, min-hits 1 (spec-draft-n-max only matters for a draft model, so it doesn't apply here).

Full line on llama.cpp 0.6.0: --spec-type ngram-map-k -ub 2048 -c 196608 -ngl 99 --jinja. 

Acceptance on code edits is 90 to 96% with ~44-token drafts, so edits run ~170 tok/s while new text stays ~50. 

I also tried ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod and ngram-cache: none beat plain ngram-map-k on edits, and none speed up new text.
